prompt:
Edit the attached Ethan pixel sprite sheet to create a WALK-ONLY sprite sheet. The attached sheet is the exact character identity reference: blue gray swept hair, black square glasses, dark navy office clothes, red narrow tie, short dark pants and shoes. Preserve the same chunky pixel style, head shape, face, colors and head/body proportions. Do not redesign the character.
Output one genuinely transparent PNG with EXACTLY 6 columns and 4 rows, 24 distinct full-body sprites, each in equal sized generously padded cells. Row 1 faces RIGHT, row 2 faces UP/back, row 3 faces LEFT, row 4 faces DOWN/front. No labels, no grid lines, no shadows, no accessories, no blur. Feet baseline and hip pivot consistently aligned in each row, same head size and head pixel silhouette throughout.
Main edit: make the LEGS visibly swing farther than the reference, approximately 1.7x stride amplitude, not longer legs. Strong readable left-right alternating walking, not shuffling, not hopping, not running. Body/head stable, only minimal natural 1 pixel vertical bob, no head shrink, no torso squash, no torso lean. Arms small relaxed opposite-leg swing, never hands-up.
Each row is a smooth six-frame cycle, in order:
1 LEFT foot extended FORWARD and RIGHT foot BACK, both feet ground contact; broad clearly separated side stride, short bent limbs.
2 weight shifts to LEFT foot, RIGHT heel lifts and knee bends forward under hip; moderately separated.
3 RIGHT leg passes LEFT leg and lifts forward, support LEFT leg vertically under hip; narrow stride.
4 RIGHT foot extended FORWARD and LEFT foot BACK, opposing contact pose to frame 1.
5 weight shifts to RIGHT foot, LEFT heel lifts and knee bends forward under hip.
6 LEFT leg passes RIGHT leg and lifts forward; opposing passing pose to frame 3.
For side views forward and backward shoe separation should be conspicuous (about 70 percent of head width at contact), but preserve the short stocky legs from reference and no skating stretched straight legs. Distinguish near leg with lighter navy highlights and far leg with darker navy, so alternating contact frames are visibly different. Front/back views alternate leg extension down towards viewer and bent lift away, not symmetric outward jumping-jack legs. Keep a relaxed walk. Exact original pixel character identity is more important than detail. Fully transparent outside character silhouettes.
